verdict.rationale: Vercel's first-party docs say users can add a custom domain, manage DNS records and get SSL certificates automatically. The CLI and REST API also cover DNS, certificate and domain automation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the custom domain flow, and in-depth docs on domain verification and per-deployment domain assignment.
